title: Away From Crafting (AFC)
description: An AFK mod that is simple yet powerful and is designed for a multiplayer environment.
body:
# Away From Crafting (AFC)
### AFC is a simple yet powerful AFK mod designed for multiplayer games. 
With easy controls and commands, you can customize your experience to the fullest!

**When the player is AFK, they will get Resistance V, Invisibility, and will not lose hunger. This will stay active until they either toggle it, move, interact with/break/place a block, interact with a mob, hit a mob, or get hit!**

## How to use AFC
**AFC uses just one keybind (by default it is set to 'X') to toggle the player's AFK mode.** You can find this key in the 'Miscellaneous' tab of the keybind settings.

AFC also uses commands! just type in 
```
/afc [argument]
```
to see the options!

## AFKBlock
**AFKBlock is a setting in AFC that allows the player to set a time where all players cannot AFK after taking damage.** By default this is set to 0 seconds, but by running 
```
/afc setBlockTime [seconds]
```
you can modify this! You can also run
```
/afc getBlockTime
```
to see what it is currently set to! To turn it off, just set the time to 0 seconds.
